23:106.text: They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were

23:107.text: "Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If ever we return
, then indeed we shall be Zâlimûn:

23:108.text: will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me!"

23:109.text: Verily there was a party of My slaves, who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!"

23:110.text: But you took them for a laughing stock, so much so that they made you forget My Remembrance while you used to laugh at them!

23:111.text: Verily I have rewarded them this Day for their patience: they are indeed the ones that are successful.

23:112.text: will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth?"

23:113.text: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account."

23:114.text: will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!

23:115.text: "Did you think that We had created you in play
, and that you would not be brought back to Us?"

23:116.text: So Exalted be Allâh, the True King: Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
, the Lord of the Supreme Throne!

23:117.text: , of whom he has no proof; then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely! Al-Kâfirûn
(the disbelievers in Allâh and in the Oneness of Allâh, polytheists, pagans, idolaters)

23:118.text: : "My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!"
